description: A light gray long-sleeve shirt lies on a red bedspread in front of you, with a white pillow at the top of the bed. The left hand reaches forward to grab and spread the shirt flat while the right hand steadies the opposite side, then both hands fold one side inward and smooth it, fold the other side over to make a long rectangle, and finally fold that rectangle in half into a compact, neatly stacked bundle before releasing it.
